about_item: Excellent Sound Quality - Through Ogogrs' advanced bone conduction technology, it allows you to feel the excellent audio transmitted through the bones. The clear sound and strong volume give you the best listening experience. The bone conduction headphones with a built-in microphone are suitable for remote video conferences.

Comfortable Fit - The lightweight titanium frame enables you to wear it for a long time without getting tired, and it remains stable during high-intensity training. It is firm and has good toughness, and can be bent freely.These running headphones are not only comfortable but also flexible and durable.

Long Battery Life & Fast Charge - You can enjoy up to 10 hours of music or calls. The wireless headphones supports safe and stable Type-C fast charging.Save time and hassle with Ogogrs open ear headphones.

Safety & Connection - Headphones bone conduction ensures that you can know the surrounding environment when enjoying your favorite audio. Compared with traditional earplugs or earmuff headphones, the safety is enhanced. Bluetooth 5.3 can achieve fast connection and stable seamless music playback.
Waterproof Function - The waterproof rating of these sports headphones is IP55 and they can be used in many sports, such as running, hiking, cycling, and even extreme sports.
